## Primary Service Deliverables
- **Custom Web Application Development:** Full-stack TypeScript, Next.js App Router, React Server Components, Node.js, and PostgreSQL backend engineering.
- **Shopify Development:** Custom Shopify 2.0 Liquid themes, headless storefronts via Shopify Storefront GraphQL API, and Indian payment/logistics integration.
- **Next.js Engineering:** Sub-second edge rendering (SSR/SSG), Core Web Vitals optimization, and enterprise dashboard architecture.
- **E-Commerce Solutions:** Custom checkout funnels, Razorpay/PhonePe UPI integration, Cash on Delivery (COD) OTP verification, and automated Shiprocket 3PL fulfillment.
- **WordPress Engineering:** Modern PHP 8 themes, native Gutenberg blocks, WooCommerce tuning, and enterprise security hardening.
